newsitem.title: UK: British soldier dies after beating in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: British soldier dies after beating in Croatia.

text.p: A British soldier serving with the NATO-led peace force in former Yugoslavia has died after being beaten by Croatian youths, the ministry of defence said on Wednesday.

Simon Lee Jeans, a member of Britain's Royal Logistics Corps, was flown back to Britain after he and five other soldiers were set upon on September 7 near the Croatian city of Split by around 30 youths armed with sticks.
A ministry of defence spokesman said Jeans died in hospital in Britain on Tuesday.
Jeans was serving in a support batallion for British troops deployed in Croatia as part of Bosnia's multinational peace implementation force (IFOR).
